subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should configured `agents.defaults.userTimezone` affect reset/delete archive basenames by adding a local-date prefix while preserving the UTC suffix?
rationale: This is a persisted session archive filename contract change, and the linked request is labeled as an enhancement needing product review rather than an established bug-fix contract.

options.title: Bless Prefixed UTC Suffix
options.body: Accept the Option B filename contract after QMD/archive reader parity and real configured reset/delete proof are added.

options.title: Keep UTC Filenames
options.body: Leave archive basenames UTC-only and solve local-date discovery through a separate listing/search/display surface.

options.title: Defer To Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused until the open feature issue receives an explicit maintainer filename policy decision.

recommendation.title: Bless Prefixed UTC Suffix
recommendation.body: Accept the Option B filename contract after QMD/archive reader parity and real configured reset/delete proof are added.
